# Pull Request Checklist

<!-- If you are done with a topic mark the checkboxes with an `x` (like `[x]`) -->

- [x] I read and understood the tasks.
- [x] I created a script that downloads the first three months of 2025 Green Taxi data.
- [x] I stored the downloaded files in a local staging directory.
- [x] I created an ETL or ELT pipeline that reads the locally staged files.
- [x] I calculated revenue per day.
- [x] I documented how to run the project.
- [x] I answered the project review questions in my README.
- [x] I ran the project locally and verified the expected outputs.

Optional extension:

- [x] I used Prefect for workflow orchestration.
